title: MacroEngineBaseline
description: Output JSON produced by running a list of MacroEngineCases through substituteParams. Used as ground truth (when engine='sillytavern-original') and as candidate (when engine='miniapp').

schemaVersion.description: Bumps when case/output shape changes incompatibly.

results.description: One entry per case, in the same order as the input case list.

runAt.description: Wall-clock time when the runner started.

stVersion.description: ST package version (window.SillyTavern context if available).

input.description: Verbatim copy of MacroEngineCase.input. Embedded so a baseline file is replayable on its own.

text.description: The string returned by substituteParams(). Primary diff target.

macrosUsed.description: Sorted unique list of macro names that were actually invoked during evaluation. Captured by wrapping MacroEngine#resolveMacro.

warnings.description: Lex/parse/runtime warnings collected from MacroDiagnostics during this case.

envSnapshot.description: JSON-safe snapshot of MacroEnv after MacroEnvBuilder.buildFromRawEnv (functions stripped, character lazy getters resolved). Used to localize diff sources, not asserted bit-exactly.

error.description: Non-null when the case threw before producing output.
